AI-enhanced malware automates victim profiling for faster credential theft

• Volta-Autodoxer uses an LLM to automatically profile and prioritize stolen credentials for attackers.
• Apple CEO John Ternus says AI will be used selectively, aiming for products people love rather than AI for AI’s sake.
• Pika H3 Flex creates synchronized video and stereo audio in six steps, handling up to 12 references.

items.text:
New malware uses an AI model to size up its victims.

• It steals passwords, cookies, payment cards and crypto wallet seed phrases.
• It digs through Gmail for receipts, order history and location data.
• Researchers have not yet seen it used in real attacks.

Do this: Review the passwords and payment cards saved in your browser.

items.hook: AI completed a live mouse brain injection[S6].
items.text:
AI completed a live mouse brain injection.

• 19 therapy options were evaluated by the AI.
• Claude Opus 5.5 refused to inject, citing safety.
• Claude Sonnet 5 performed the injection successfully.

Our read: The test shows both the promise and the safety limits of AI in the lab.
